title: .dockerignore 匹配器（glob 语义含 ** / * / 否定 !）
expected_output:
=== .dockerignore 匹配模拟 ===
规则列表:
  .git
  **/node_modules
  **/__pycache__
  *.log
  !keep.log
  build/
  **/*.tmp

上下文文件总数 = 14
被排除 (8):
  - .git/config
  - .git/HEAD
  - run.log
  - src/node_modules/pkg/index.js
  - src/__pycache__/app.cpython-313.pyc
  - build/out.bin
  - tmp/a.tmp
  - tmp/sub/b.tmp
保留   (6):
  + README.md
  + Dockerfile
  + keep.log
  + src/app.py
  + src/utils.py
  + logs/app.log

=== 易错点验证 ===
logs/app.log 被 *.log 排除了吗: False（* 不跨 /，子目录要写 **/*.log）
run.log 被 *.log 排除了吗: True
keep.log 先被 *.log 命中、再被 !keep.log 重新包含 -> 最终保留: True
否定规则 ! 是否生效: True
src/node_modules/pkg/index.js 被 **/node_modules 排除: True
build/ 作为目录规则排除其下所有文件: True

结论: 少了 .dockerignore，COPY . 会把 .git、依赖目录、日志一起送进构建上下文，
      既拖慢构建，又让「只改一个日志文件」就击穿整条缓存链: True
code:
import re

# .dockerignore 语义：
#   *  匹配任意字符但**不跨 /**
#   ** 匹配任意层级（**/x 表示任意目录下的 x）
#   ?  匹配单个非 / 字符
#   以 / 结尾表示目录（连同其内容一起排除）
#   !  开头的规则表示「不排除」，且**最后一条命中的规则生效**

RULES = [".git", "**/node_modules", "**/__pycache__", "*.log", "!keep.log",
         "build/", "**/*.tmp"]

FILES = [".git/config", ".git/HEAD", "README.md", "Dockerfile", "keep.log",
         "run.log", "src/app.py", "src/utils.py",
         "src/node_modules/pkg/index.js",
         "src/__pycache__/app.cpython-313.pyc",
         "logs/app.log", "build/out.bin", "tmp/a.tmp", "tmp/sub/b.tmp"]


def glob_to_regex(pattern):
    i, out = 0, []
    n = len(pattern)
    while i < n:
        if pattern.startswith("**/", i):
            out.append("(?:.*/)?")
            i += 3
        elif pattern.startswith("**", i):
            out.append(".*")
            i += 2
        elif pattern[i] == "*":
            out.append("[^/]*")
            i += 1
        elif pattern[i] == "?":
            out.append("[^/]")
            i += 1
        else:
            out.append(re.escape(pattern[i]))
            i += 1
    return "^" + "".join(out) + "$"


def compile_rule(raw):
    neg = raw.startswith("!")
    pat = raw[1:] if neg else raw
    dir_only = pat.endswith("/")
    pat = pat.rstrip("/")
    rx = re.compile(glob_to_regex(pat) + ("(?:/.*)?" if dir_only else ""))
    return neg, rx, raw


def ancestors(path):
    parts = path.split("/")
    return ["/".join(parts[:i]) for i in range(1, len(parts) + 1)]


def is_excluded(path, rules):
    """最后一条命中的规则说了算（Docker 的语义）。"""
    decision = False
    for neg, rx, raw in rules:
        matched = any(rx.match(a) for a in ancestors(path))
        if matched:
            decision = not neg
    return decision


compiled = [compile_rule(r) for r in RULES]
print("=== .dockerignore 匹配模拟 ===")
print("规则列表:")
for r in RULES:
    print("  %s" % r)
print()
excluded = [f for f in FILES if is_excluded(f, compiled)]
kept = [f for f in FILES if not is_excluded(f, compiled)]
print("上下文文件总数 = %d" % len(FILES))
print("被排除 (%d):" % len(excluded))
for f in excluded:
    print("  - %s" % f)
print("保留   (%d):" % len(kept))
for f in kept:
    print("  + %s" % f)
print()
print("=== 易错点验证 ===")
print("logs/app.log 被 *.log 排除了吗: %s（* 不跨 /，子目录要写 **/*.log）"
      % is_excluded("logs/app.log", compiled))
print("run.log 被 *.log 排除了吗: %s" % is_excluded("run.log", compiled))
print("keep.log 先被 *.log 命中、再被 !keep.log 重新包含 -> 最终保留: %s"
      % (not is_excluded("keep.log", compiled)))
print("否定规则 ! 是否生效: %s" % (not is_excluded("keep.log", compiled)))
print("src/node_modules/pkg/index.js 被 **/node_modules 排除: %s"
      % is_excluded("src/node_modules/pkg/index.js", compiled))
print("build/ 作为目录规则排除其下所有文件: %s" % is_excluded("build/out.bin", compiled))
print()
print("结论: 少了 .dockerignore，COPY . 会把 .git、依赖目录、日志一起送进构建上下文，")
print("      既拖慢构建，又让「只改一个日志文件」就击穿整条缓存链: True")
